# Vibecode audit — poc-genere

Generated by /vibecode-audit on 2026-10-17. Axes: security, maintainability, evolvability. complete audit.

> **Default order.** No interaction was possible: the attack order and the fate of the minor patterns are the skill's defaults, with no arbitration by the user.

> **Family not audited: injection.** Its auditor returned no usable JSON block after a relaunch: it is listed among the unauditable surfaces.

> **Scope and limits of this audit.** Read-only static diagnosis, produced by a language
> model. It does not replace an application security review: no access to the runtime
> environment, to credentials, to the real configuration of third-party services or to traffic; no
> penetration test. The auditor shares some of the blind spots of the model that produced the code —
> the absence of a finding on a family proves nothing. The surfaces listed below could not be
> audited at all.
>
> **Validation.** 5 patterns out of 6 passed the adversarial validation. The others are
> marked `not validated`: they were not refuted, they were not verified.
>
> **Difficulties are orders of magnitude, not estimates.** They vary from one audit to
> another on the same code. Severity, on the other hand, is stable: the order rests on it.

## Patterns in detail
### VIB-01 — Les points d'entrée de modification ne vérifient pas l'appartenance de la ressource
- **Axis / severity / difficulty**: security / critical / M — **occurrences**: 13 (sample below)
- **Regression risk**: high — aucun test sur ces points d'entrée, 14 appelants *(information, not part of the order)*
- **Impact**: un utilisateur modifie la ressource d'autrui en changeant l'identifiant
- **Occurrences**: `api/orders.js:42`, `api/users.js:88`, `api/items.js:17`, `api/carts.js:9`, … (+9)
- **Pattern fix**: vérifier l'appartenance côté serveur dans une couche commune
- **Status**: A_FAIRE

### VIB-02 — Le schéma de données est modifié sans historique de migration
- **Axis / severity / difficulty**: evolvability / critical / L — **occurrences**: 1
- **Regression risk**: high — toute la persistance en dépend *(information, not part of the order)*
- **Impact**: impossible de rejouer la base ailleurs
- **Occurrences**: `db/schema.sql:1`
- **Pattern fix**: introduire des migrations versionnées
- **Status**: A_FAIRE

### VIB-03 — Le montant de la commande est fourni par le client
- **Axis / severity / difficulty**: security / major / S — **occurrences**: 2
- **Regression risk**: medium — deux appelants, un test de paiement *(information, not part of the order)*
- **Impact**: paiement d'un montant arbitraire
- **Occurrences**: `api/checkout.js:21`, `api/refund.js:8`
- **Pattern fix**: recalculer les montants côté serveur
- **Status**: A_FAIRE

### VIB-04 — Les règles d'âge divergent entre client et serveur
- **Axis / severity / difficulty**: maintainability / major / S — **occurrences**: 2
- **Regression risk**: medium — trois fichiers sans tests *(information, not part of the order)*
- **Impact**: des saisies acceptées côté client sont refusées côté serveur
- **Occurrences**: `web/form.js:30`, `api/users.js:12`
- **Pattern fix**: une seule source des règles
- **Status**: A_FAIRE

### VIB-05 — Le formatage des dates est réécrit localement
- **Axis / severity / difficulty**: maintainability / minor / XS — **occurrences**: 1
- **Regression risk**: medium — trois fichiers sans tests *(information, not part of the order)*
- **Impact**: des saisies acceptées côté client sont refusées côté serveur
- **Occurrences**: `web/date.js:4`
- **Pattern fix**: une seule source des règles
- **Status**: A_FAIRE

### VIB-06 — Des commentaires paraphrasent le code
- **Axis / severity / difficulty**: maintainability / minor / XS — **occurrences**: 1
- **Regression risk**: low — commentaires seulement *(information, not part of the order)*
- **Impact**: bruit à la lecture
- **Occurrences**: `api/orders.js:3`
- **Pattern fix**: dire pourquoi, pas quoi
- **Status**: A_FAIRE
